obligations.text: (2)A civil penalty collected pursuant to this subdivision shall be paid to the office of the public prosecutor that brought the action.
A penalty collected pursuant to this section by the Attorney General shall be deposited into the Public Rights Law Enforcement Special Fund.
(2)If the actual harm alleged in an action pursuant to paragraph (1) is financial harm, the amount of the harm alleged shall exceed one thousand dollars ($1,000) per child.
(3)If the actual harm alleged in an action pursuant to paragraph (1) is emotional harm, the harm must constitute serious emotional distress.
(c)A violation of this chapter shall not constitute a basis for a private cause of action under the Unfair Competition Law (Chapter 5 (commencing with Section 17200) of Part 2 of Division 7).
